ops.target_ref: Paragraph II.C.5 (Basement) of Section II. DEFINITIONS
ops.new_text: 5. Basement. Any area of a building, including any sunken room or sunken portion of a room, having its floor below ground level on all sides, and any area having a finished floor more than two feet below the adjoining exterior grade on at least three sides.
